verses.2590: falā budda min shakwā ʾilā llāhi kurbatī famāliyā ghayra llāhi jābiru kasratī
verses.2591: yunāziʿunī karbī sh-shadīdu falam ʾajid khalāṣā bihi ʾillā l-ʾilaha waʿizzatī
verses.2592: wa qarʿiyā bāba l-ghayri yā rabbi lam yufid lidhāka ṣarafnā naḥwa bābika wijhatī
verses.2593: ʾunājīka yāllahu rabbī wakhāliqī ʾaghithniyā yā mawlāyā min kulli shiddati
verses.2594: faʾanta karīmu fal-karīmu mani t-tajā ʾilā bābihi yaʾa man ʿalā kulli niqmahi
verses.2595: waʾanta ʿazīzu fal-ʿazīzu mani ʾitawā ʾilā bābihi yukfā lahu kulla ḍaymati
verses.2596: faʾanta ḥalīmu yā ṣabūru liman jafā fahā ʾanā ʿabdu jiʾitu bādiyā dhillahi
verses.2597: fabābuka man wāfāhu yaḥẓā rajaaʾahu wayanjuwa min ṭardi wayalqā biʿiṭfahi
verses.2598: falammā badā lī ʾannahu laysa mahrabu siwā bābika l-ḥāmī madadtu yudayyatī
verses.2599: walammā raʾaytu l-khalqa lā ḥawla ʿindahum walā quwwata ʾalqaytu wajhī linuṣrati
verses.2600: ʾilayka biḍuʿfi wāftiqāri wafāqati litaghfira lī yā rabbi min kulli zallatī
verses.2601: litaghfira lī kulla dh-dhunūbi faʾinnahā kabaḥri ṭamā yaṭghā wayarmī biquwwati
verses.2602: fabayna yaday mawlāyā māziltu wāqifā dhalīlā ḥaqīrā mustaghīthā lishiddatī
verses.2603: faḥāshāka yā rabba l-bariyyati ʾan yurā nazīluka maḥrūmā wayulqā bikhaybati
verses.2604: faʾanta ʾilahī yā mujību liman daʿā daʿawtuka yā sattāru fāstur maʿībatī
verses.2605: kamā qad daʿānā lin-nidāʾi daʿawtuhu ʾajib daʿwatī rabbī l-karīmu biluṭfahi
verses.2606: fayā rabbanā iṣrif ʾilayka khawāṭirī bijāhi nabiyyi lil-bariyyati raḥmahi
verses.2607: wanawwir biqalbī wal-jawāriḥi kullihā bijāhi shafīʿi l-khalqi yawma l-mahībati
verses.2608: fayā ḥayyū yā qayyūmu yā llāhu rabbanā ʾilayka tawassalnā bikhayri l-bariyyati
verses.2609: huwa l-muṣṭafā wal-muntaqā dūna sābiqi wa lā lāḥiqi washāfiʿu lil-khalīqati
verses.2610: wa shaffiʿhu fīnā fī lliqāʾi wa kullunā siwā l-ḥibbi mawṣūfu biruʿbi warahbahi
verses.2611: tawassaltu yā raḥmānu bir-rusli kullihim wabīlʾanbiyā wal-ʾawliyā naẓmi ʿiqdatī
verses.2612: bīʾādama ʾidrīsi wa hūdi wa yūnusi wa lūṭi wa nūḥi thumma ḥāwi likhullahi
verses.2613: fahum khīratu qad ʾawrada dh-dhikru ṣītahum kamā ʾawrada ṣītā liʾūlī l-ʿaẓīmati
verses.2614: wa dāwūda yaʿqūbi sulaymāna yūsufi wa ʾisḥāqa ʾismāʿīla ʾilyāsa junnatī
verses.2615: lahum sīratu maḥmūdatu man yarūmuhā yasīru ʿalā sharʿi n-nabiyyī wamillahi
verses.2616: wa mūsā wa hārūni wa ʾayyūba wal-yasaʿ wadhī l-kifli yaḥyā thumma ʿīsā l-wasīlati
verses.2617: madadtu yadī lil-hi ʾarjū bijāhihim liqāʾa l-munā yawma l-jazāʾi walawmati
verses.2618: kadhā zakariyāʾu shuʿaybu wa ṣāliḥu taqīnā radā d-dārayni min kulli waḥlahi
verses.2619: watuʿṭī lanā kulla l-ʾamānī waʾaṣliḥan ʾumūra l-warā ṭurrā bifaḍli waminḥahi
verses.2620: wamin ʾāli bayti l-muṣṭafā jamʿu shamlinā biʾaṣḥābihi kashfu sh-shidādi l-muhībati
verses.2621: bihim fāghfiran mā qad janaynā lighaflahi waqud sayranā fawqa ṣ-ṣirāṭi biʿiṣmahi
verses.2622: biʾaqmāri badri yā ʾilahī wa sayyidī wa bil-malaʾi l-ʾaʿlā kshifan kulla ghummahi
verses.2623: wabīlʾawliyāʾi ṣ-ṣāliḥīna linahjinā wabīlbarzakhi l-makhtūmi nūri d-dujunnati
verses.2624: ʾilahiyā yā mawlāyā bil-ʾarḍi wa s-samā wa mā ḥawatā faltashfinā kulla ʿillahi
verses.2625: wabīlʿarshi wal-kursiyyī wal-qalami kadhā wabīlllawḥi wal-ʾaflāki ḥaqqiq biraghbatī
verses.2626: laka l-khalqu yā mawlāyā wa l-ʾamru kulluhu wa lā takilan ʾamrī lighayrika dhukhratī
verses.2627: ʾilayka t-tajaʾatu ḥāʾirā wamukhāṭirā fakhudh wijhatī faḍlā ʾilahī waʿizzatī
verses.2628: mashāriba ʾahli l-ḥaḍratayni litasqinā ʾazil biḥijābi l-qalbi maʿ kulli qaswati
verses.2629: fasuqnā bimāʾi l-waṣli lā ṭarda baʿdahu watulbisunā thawba l-ʿināyati sitratī
verses.2630: maḍā d-dahru wal-ʾayyāmu wadh-dhanbu ḥāṣilu wa ṣāḥa ghurābu l-bayni muʿlima riḥlatī
verses.2631: maḍā d-dahru wal-ʾayyāmu wal-qalbu ghāfilu wayaṭghā ʿalayhi r-raynu min dūni ṣaḥwati
verses.2632: maḍā d-dahru wa l-ʾayyāmu wa l-jismu ʿābidu siwā llāhi wa r-raḥmānu khāliqu juththatī
verses.2633: maḍā d-dahru wal-ʾayyāmu nafsī muṣābatu bidāʾi l-hawā l-murdī bimāʾi limuhjatī
verses.2634: maḍā d-dahru wal-ʾayyāmu wa l-qalbu shākiru siwāhu wa minhu d-dahra jalbu maʿīshatī
verses.2635: maḍā d-dahru wal-ʾayyāmu wal-mawtu qādimu wazādī qalīlu lastu ʾadrī maḥaṭṭatī
verses.2636: maḍā d-dahru wal-ʾayyāmu wadh-dhanbu ḥāṣilu ʿalā ʾannanī mamlūku nafsī wa shahwatī
verses.2637: maḍā d-dahru wal-ʾayyāmu wadh-dhanbu qad ṭamā ʿalayyā famā lī ghayru rabbī biraḥmahi
verses.2638: ʾalā ʿumru wallā mustaṭāʿu rujūʿuhu faʾarʾaba mā ʾathʾaytu sāʿata ghirratī
verses.2639: ʾalā ʿumra wallā dūna ʾan ʾaʿmala lladhī ʿalā dhimmatī farḍā lirabbī waʿumdatī
verses.2640: laqad ḍāʿa ʿumru sāʿata minhu tushtarā bimilʾi s-samā wa l-ʾarḍi ʾayyata ḍayʿati
verses.2641: laqad ḍāʿa ʿumru sāʿata minhu tushtarā bimā ḍammati d-dunyā tharāʾa lifidyati
verses.2642: wa lakinnanī ʾarjū talāfiyā rabbanā wa ʾillā fahabnī hālikā ʾayyā hulkahi
verses.2643: fakam khāʾifi bil-ʿiṭfi ʾanqadhtahu wakam fakun munqidhā ʿabdā ẓalūmā lishahwati
verses.2644: ʾalā himmatī fājʿal ʾilahī ʿaliyyata liʾan ṣirtu ḥurrā khāliṣā kulla wijhahi
verses.2645: wakun lī naṣīrā fī ʾumūrī jamīʿihā fatamliku miftāḥa l-ʾumūri birummahi
verses.2646: fayā rabbi ʾammā kuntu ghayraka ʾartajī famā ban-nā yawma l-jazāʾi waḥīlatī
verses.2647: wakayfa siwāka ʾartajī ʾanta rabbunā wakhāliqunā war-rāziqu kulla nasmahi
verses.2648: ʾalā khāba ʾāmālī lighayrika rabbanā kamā nghalaqat ʾillā ʾilayka ṭarīqatī
verses.2649: fasubḥāna man yujrī l-mashīʾata fī l-warā wāʾālāʾuhu tasrī ʿumūma l-bariyyati
verses.2650: wa māliyā rabbī ʿan qaḍāʾika maʿdilu fahabniyā ʾan ʾarḍā bimarri l-qaḍiyyati
verses.2651: qaḍāʾuka fīnā ḥākimu wamunaffidhu biḥulwi wamurri qāʾimu dūna riddati
verses.2652: wa hab liyā fī l-ʾamri th-thabāta ʿazīmata ʿalā r-rushdi hab lī sh-shukra min kulli niʿmahi
verses.2653: wahab liyā ʾan ʾarḍā bihi kulla ḥālati qaḍāʾuka yajrī fī l-barāyā biḥikmahi
verses.2654: wa ʾasʾaluka t-taqwā wa ḥusna ʿibādati wa nayla marāmī yā ʾilahī wa bughyatī
verses.2655: waʾasʾaluka ṣ-ṣabra l-jamīla bikulli mā yuṣādifunī ʿumrī liqāʾa l-baliyyati
verses.2656: wa ʾasʾalu rabbī llāha min khayri kullimā bihi ʿālimu ghawthī ʿimādī wa nuṣratī
verses.2657: waʾasʾaluhu nayla r-raghāʾibi kullihā mina l-fawzi was-saʿdi waʿulwi lihimmahi
verses.2658: ʾaʿūdhu bika ṭ-ṭaghwā wa min sharri kullimā ʿalimta bihi yā rabbi jābira kasratī
verses.2659: ʾaʿūdhu bikum min qabḍaḍi n-nafsi wal-hawā wamin sharri shayṭāni wajinni wasikkahi
verses.2660: wa ʾastaghfiru l-ghaffāra min sharri kullimā bihi ʿālimu yā ʿālimā kulla khubʾatī
verses.2661: ʾatūbu ʾilayka bil-maʿāṣī faʾinnahu huwa l-ghāfiru l-bārru waqābilu tawbati
verses.2662: faʾinnaka ʾanta l-ʿālimu l-ghaybi kullihi saʾaltuka ʾamnā yā naṣīrī wa ʿizzatī
verses.2663: waʾanta ʿalā kulli l-khafāyā muṭalliʿu wataʿlamu mā tukhfī ṣ-ṣudūru bighaybatī
verses.2664: ʾalā ḥasbunā llāhu l-jalīlu jalālata wa niʿma l-wakīlu llāhu nawwir baṣīratī
verses.2665: ʾalā ḥasbunā llāhu l-jamīlu ṣifātuhu waʾasmāʾuhu l-ḥusnā simātu liqudsati
verses.2666: ʾaʿūdhu birabbī l-hādi min jawri jāʾiri wa min makri ʿādi mākiri ʾayyā makratī
verses.2667: waghayẓi wamin shari kadhalika ghayratu wamin kulli ʾamri jālibi lil-maḍarrati
verses.2668: wa ẓulmi liẓallāmi wa siḥri lisāḥiri wa baghyi libāghi yā ʾilahī wa ʿuddatī
verses.2669: wanāri wagharqi wal-khiyānati wal-jawā waghammi wadāʾi wal-ʿirāki wa fitnati
verses.2670: kadhā ḥasadu l-ḥussādi ghadru lighādiri wa kaydu likulli l-kāʾidīna bihulkahi
verses.2671: kadhāka nifāqu wal-ghurūru ʾilahanā kadhalika kufru fāqatu fī l-maʿīshati
verses.2672: kadhāka ʾilaha l-ʿālamīna ʿadāwatu likulli ʿaduwwi yabtaghī d-dahra ṣawlatī
verses.2673: waman qad saʿā fī ʾan yarāniyā fāshilā ʾaʿūdhu bika minhu ʾilahī waʿumdatī
verses.2674: wa ṭaʿnu liṭaʿʿāni wa qadḥu liqādiḥi wa min ḥiyali l-muḥtāli min ʾayyī ḥīlati
verses.2675: faḥḥuṭa l-masāʿī wal-ʾamānī ladayhimu mina n-nafthi wal-ʿaqdi lifatkī wamiḥnatī
verses.2676: shamātatu shammāti wa kashḥu likāshiḥi ʾilahī qinā fī d-dahri kulla baliyyati
verses.2677: ʾaghithnī ʾilahī yā mujību limuḍṭari ʾatā naḥwakum yabghī l-ʿilāja liʿillahi
verses.2678: ʾaṣūlu bika l-ʾaʿdā kadhā quranāʾanā wa ʾiyāka ʾarjū min walāʾi l-ʾaḥibbahi
verses.2679: wamin nuṣrati l-ʾikhwāni fī sh-shiddi war-rakhā musānadati l-jīrāni fī kulli wafqahi
verses.2680: wa min qurabāʾī yā ʾilāhī wa sayyidī laka l-ḥamdu mimmā laysa tuḥṣīhi qudratī
verses.2681: ʿajaztu biʾan ʾuḥṣī binaʿmāka rabbanā wajūdī yuḥḥiqu l-ḥamda dawmā bifayḍaḍi
verses.2682: walā ʿaddahu ʿaddu ʿawāʾida faḍlika l-ʿamīmi wa min ʿawāriqi r-rizqi sitratī
verses.2683: waʿāmaltanā luṭfā khafiyyā yaḥḥufunā waluṭfuka malḥūẓu ladā kulli nafsati
verses.2684: wa ʾalwānu mā ʾawlaytanī rabbanā bihi mina r-rifdi wa l-ʾikrāmi wāsiʿa raḥmahi
verses.2685: ʾilahiyā ʾanta l-wāḥidu l-māliku lladhī fāʾāthāruhu tabdū ʿalā kulli khalqahi
verses.2686: ʾilāhiyā lā rabbu siwāka fayurtajā faʾinnaka fāshī l-ḥamdi ʿinda l-khalīqati
verses.2687: wakullu lisāni yarfaʿu ṣ-ṣawta hātifā bidhikrika wal-ḥamdi l-madīdi biniʿmahi
verses.2688: wa ʾanta ʾilāhī bāsiṭu l-yadi fī n-nadā wa ghayru muḍāddi yā ʾilāhī biḥikmahi
verses.2689: fakayfa tuḍādu wal-maqādīru kulluhā biʾalwānihā ḥasba l-mashīʾati ḥallati
verses.2690: wafī l-ʾamri was-sulṭāni wal-mulki lā munā ziʿu laka mawlānā fayassir bimunyatī
verses.2691: waʾanta khabīru bil-ʾumūri taṣarrufā wataʿlamuhā mahmā takun dūna khufyati
verses.2692: famā laka mawlānā ʾilāhī mushāriku rubūbiyyata rabbī ghiyāthī wa ʿumdatī
verses.2693: famā laka mawlānā ʾilāhī muʿānidu waman ʿānada l-mawlā yaʿīshu biḍankahi
verses.2694: wa fī l-khalqi yā mawlāyā ghāru muzāḥami liʾannaka fī l-ʾibdāʿi mawṣūfu waḥdati
verses.2695: wafī l-khalqi yā mawlāyā ghayru musāʾali ʿalā l-ḥukmi yā rabbī rajāʾa l-bariyyati
verses.2696: wa ʾanta mina l-ʾakhlāqi tamliku mā tashā wa lā yamlikūna minka ghayra l-mashīʾati
verses.2697: waʾanta mina l-ʾakhlāqi tafʿalu mā tashā walā yafʿalūna qadra shibri wadharrati
verses.2698: ʾilahī biquṭbi l-ʿārifīna ʾimāminā rajāʾī wa ghawthī lil-ʾilahi wasīlatī
verses.2699: bihi futiḥat fayḍu l-wilāyati lil-warā wayaḥtallu fīhā manzilā dūna sabqahi
verses.2700: khitāmi niẓāmi lil-wilāyati jumlaha bihi ʾartajī l-ghufrāna min kulli zallahi
verses.2701: farīdu waqad ḥalla l-marātiba jumlaha fanāla l-munā min jaddihi dūna ghaflahi
verses.2702: bihi ʾartajī fatḥa l-maghāliqi kullihā wiqāyatunā t-tijāni min kulli shiddati
verses.2703: ḥayātī walam ʾaḥṣul ziyārata rawḍihi fanāru l-jawā yaṣlā l-fuʾāda bijamrati
verses.2704: wa kam ʾashtakī ʿinda l-ʾilahi ziyārata zawāyāhu lakinna l-ʿināna biqabḍaḍi
verses.2705: wayaḥmilunī qalbī l-kalīmu bishawqihi fahā qad qaḍā l-mawlā lanā khayra furṣati
verses.2706: ʾunādī wa hal yujdī n-nidāʾu ʾakhā l-jawā hali d-dahru yuʿṭīnī murādī waraghbatī
verses.2707: murādī ziyārātu sh-sharīfi ʾimāminā malādhī ʾabī l-ʿabbāsi kanzi l-ʿiṭiyyati
verses.2708: wa mā ziltu ʾarjūhā mina llāhi waḥdahu wa ʾin lam ʾanalhā yā marārata ʿīshatī
verses.2709: wanafsī tumannīnī bihā kulla laḥẓaḍi waṭāra l-hawā naḥwa l-ḥabībi liruʾuyati
verses.2710: waʿadta wa ʾanta l-waʿdu ʿindaka ṣādiqu ʾijābata dāʿi dhī ḍṭirāri wa dhillahi
verses.2711: wamā khāba ʿabdu ʾammakum wamutayyamu yunāziʿuhu dhikru l-ḥabībi liriḥlahi
verses.2712: ʾilahiyā fāʿfu l-wālidīna dhunūbahum kadhalika yā raḥmānu kulla l-mashīkhati
verses.2713: waṭayyib tharāhum fī l-qubūri walaṭṭifan bihim rabbanā yā ʿālimā kulla nuqṭati
verses.2714: kadhalika ʾikhwānī ʾilahiyā jumlaha waman yantamī rabbī ʾilā khayri millatī
verses.2715: waman yantamī ʿahdā ʾilā sh-shaykhi ʾaḥmada t-tijānī man qāda l-ʾanāma lijannati
verses.2716: wa ʾazkā ṣalāti llāhi thumma salāmihi ʿalā khayri khalqi llāhi min ghayri thunyati
verses.2717: yadūmāni mā qad zayyala sh-shiʿra umruʾu linayli luḥūqi bir-rukābi bisurʿahi
verses.2718: maʿa l-ʾāli wa l-ʾaṣḥābi mā dharra shāriqu wa mā qāla dāʿi yā ʾilahī lishiddatī
verses.2719: wamā dhayyala l-manṣūru shiʿrā lijaddihi falā budda min shakwā ʾilā llāhi kurbatī
